items.title: Earl Humphrey Interview, 1963-03-28
items.q: Oh, yeah, man. He, Portrait's Market Dan, stayed in the district back then. And he, he guitar player.

ctx.x: Yeah, August Lanois. Well, he married, uh, one of, uh, I don't know. Yeah, he had, had, had two dollars, I know.
I hate to change the subject, but I want to know about this Portrait's Market Dan. Who did he bum with? If we could find anything about him.

Oh, yeah, man. He, Portrait's Market Dan, stayed in the district back then. And he, he guitar player. He couldn't sing, but he could talk and rhyme. He, he's a fool out there and, you know, them prostitutes all back in the district down there, you know, all around good time places. Him and George Jones and Cornelius and all them, that string aggregation. Well, when they needed some instruments, you know, blowing instruments, well, they come out and get them out there on the lake there, but they need some horns,…
